title: National Foods Ltd - proposed acquisition of Berri Limited

body_sections.Summary: On 31 August 2005 the ACCC advised National Foods it would not oppose the transfer by San Miguel to them of 51% of Berri's shares.
body_sections.Market definition: For competition analysis purposes the ACCC considered the following markets which are serviced by National Foods: 1. the regional market for raw milk; 2. the market for fresh milk on a state basis; 3. the market for flavoured milk on a state basis; 4. the national market for cream; 5. the national market for dairy desserts and yoghurt; and 6. the national market for cheese.
body_sections.Competition analysis: As the transfer of shares is part of an internal corporate restructure, there will be no change in effective corporate control. Based upon this factor the ACCC formed the view that a substantial lessening of competition in a market was unlikely to occur.
